newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-PROLIFIC JAYASURIYA HITS UNBEATEN 149.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PROLIFIC JAYASURIYA HITS UNBEATEN 149.

text.p: Sri Lanka opener Sanath Jayasuriya continued his run spree against India with an unbeaten 149 in the second and final test on Tuesday to become the first batsman to score 1,000 test runs this year.
Jayasuriya helped to carry Sri Lanka's second innings from the overnight 77 for one to 282 for two, a lead of 239, at tea on the fourth day.
Jayasuriya and Aravinda de Silva, who stroked 57 not out, shared an unfinished third wicket partnership of 137.
Having piled up 340, the fourth highest individual score in test history, in the drawn first test last week, Jayasuriya continued to flay the Indian bowlers here.
He struck one six and 10 fours in reaching his fourth test hundred in 264 minutes off 137 balls.

De Silva, who made a century in the first innings, reached his 15th test half-century off 116 balls in 132 minutes with six fours. He shrugged off a shaky start in which he nearly skied a catch to mid-off and was bowled by a no-ball from Abey Kuruvila.
India's solitary success was Roshan Mahanama's wicket in the first session at 145.
